## The question

[Find the area between the given function , and two tangents off of the point (2,-2)](https://math.stackexchange.com/questions/1411913/find-the-area-between-the-given-function-and-two-tangents-off-of-the-point-2), asked by [England](https://math.stackexchange.com/users/264936/england) on Mathematics Stack Exchange (2015-08-27; [CC BY-SA 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/)):

> So here is a general graph of the first couple directions. 
> [![graph][q-1]][q-1]
>
> $T_1$ and $T_2$ are supposed to be the points where the tangent line intersects the parabola. The tangent lines and points where the tangent line intersect the parabola are not exact placements, just a visual aid.
>
>
>
> I'm supposed to find the area of the yellow highlighted area. I understand how to find the area but I don't get how to find the equations of the tangent lines with the given point $(2,-2)$ to find where they intersect with $y = x^2$.
>
>
>   [q-1]: ak4OR.jpg
:::

Here is a hint: you need to find the points $(a,a^2)$ on the parabola such that the tangent line through that point also passes through $(2,-2)$.
